QUOTE: `ExternalBridge::run_async_ask` (`:1158`) | Runs `entropic_run` for an async `entropic.ask` | **Detached**; "The async-ask worker is the one the caller never waits on."; "`run_async_ask` is `std::thread(...).detach()`-style: nothing joins it"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as the sole detached thread and says nothing joins it, so it outlives its caller's scope.
